import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train.csv"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test.csv"
SUBMISSION_PATH = "./submission/submission.csv"
TARGET_COLUMNS = [
    "toxic",
    "severe_toxic",
    "obscene",
    "threat",
    "insult",
    "identity_hate",
]
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# Text Preprocessing
texts = train_df["comment_text"].fillna("").astype(str)
texts_test = test_df["comment_text"].fillna("").astype(str)

# Word-level TF-IDF (1,2 n-grams)
vectorizer_word = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2), lowercase=True, min_df=2
)
X_word_train = vectorizer_word.fit_transform(texts)
X_word_test = vectorizer_word.transform(texts_test)

# Character-level TF-IDF (2,3 n-grams)
vectorizer_char = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 3), max_features=10000, lowercase=True, min_df=2
)
X_char_train = vectorizer_char.fit_transform(texts)
X_char_test = vectorizer_char.transform(texts_test)

# Concatenate word + character features
X_train = hstack([X_word_train, X_char_train])
X_test = hstack([X_word_test, X_char_test])

# Labels
y_train = train_df[TARGET_COLUMNS].values

# Hold-out Validation Split
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Initialize Models
models = []
for i in range(len(TARGET_COLUMNS)):
    clf = LogisticRegression(solver="sag", max_iter=1000, n_jobs=-1, random_state=42)
    clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr[:, i])
    models.append(clf)

# Validation Metric Calculation (Column-wise ROC AUC)
y_val_preds = []
for i in range(len(TARGET_COLUMNS)):
    y_val_preds.append(models[i].predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1])
y_val_preds = np.array(y_val_preds)

val_auc_scores = []
for i in range(len(TARGET_COLUMNS)):
    y_pred_i = y_val_preds[i]
    val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], y_pred_i)
    val_auc_scores.append(val_auc)

mean_val_auc = np.mean(val_auc_scores)
print(f"Validation Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_val_auc:.4f}")

# Predictions on Test Set
y_test_preds = []
for i in range(len(TARGET_COLUMNS)):
    y_test_preds.append(models[i].predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1])
y_test_preds = np.array(y_test_preds)

# Transpose to get (n_samples, n_targets) for DataFrame creation
y_test_preds = y_test_preds.T

# Prepare Submission - preserve exact format
sub_df = pd.DataFrame(y_test_preds, columns=TARGET_COLUMNS)
sub_df.insert(0, "id", test_df["id"])
# Ensure column order matches sample submission
final_columns = ["id"] + TARGET_COLUMNS
sub_df = sub_df[final_columns]
sub_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print("Submission saved to", SUBMISSION_PATH)
print(f"Submission shape: {sub_df.shape}")
print(f"Submission columns: {list(sub_df.columns)}")
